findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Test. `OWN_REVIEWS` still appends to `review-starts.jsonl` without the new lock-safe helper. The land test starts two closes concurrently, and `_in_close` requires both review-start records. Concurrent Windows append handles can overwrite a record, leaving the test intermittently failing despite the supplied green run.
